The EU Parliament’s trade negotiator @berndlange tells me Trump’s “angry mood” is behind his decisions to impose new tariffs on the EU and withdraw US troops from Germany: “I'm sure that it is. It is not based on economic developments. We are not doing any unfair trading practice. This is really linked to some angry mood he has against specifically Germany. And, you know, also the discussion about this relationship with my chancellor in Germany.”

Video

Breaking: The US will withdraw roughly 5,000 troops from Germany over the next 6-12 months. As of December 2025, there were 36,436 active-duty US military personnel permanently stationed in Germany.

“The Secretary of War has ordered the withdrawal of approximately 5,000 troops from Germany," Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said in a statement obtained by CNN.  "This decision follows a thorough review of the Department’s force posture in Europe and is in recognition of theater requirements

New: At least 16 American military sites have been damaged in Iranian strikes, making up the majority of US positions in the Middle East, a new CNN investigation can reveal. The damage includes high-value targets, raising questions about America’s footprint in the region.

Question: What are the Iranian people feeling today?

“I think they're feeling very alone, especially if you were one of those protesters in the anti-regime uprising in January, the regime still in power. And this regime that massacred protesters in January is now sitting across from the vice president of the United States and negotiating,” @hdagres tells me of her contacts with Iranians.

Stanford Law Professor @persily breaks down the impact of the Supreme Court’s decision on the Voting Rights Act calling it “one of the most significant election law decisions the Supreme Court has ever issued…it has taken out one of the major protections against discrimination in the redistricting process.”

Video

PM Netanyahu’s foreign policy advisor @FalkOphir tells me that - despite the claimed ceasefire- Israel “had to go back to war” in Lebanon due to Hezbollah attacks:

"Hezbollah is breaching the ceasefire. That's not surprising, and we're hitting them back. We're hitting them back very hard. In essence, we had a ceasefire on November 24 and Hezbollah breached the ceasefire, and that's why we had to go back to war"

Video

New: Sen Mitch McConnell slams Pentagon for failing to spend #Ukraine aid passed by Congress: “Appropriators fully funded that authorization for fiscal 2026 with overwhelming support,” he wrote in The Washington Post. “Yet the Ukraine aid we passed months ago is now collecting dust at the Pentagon.”

I look forward to speaking to Belgian Defense Minister @FranckenTheo following his meeting with US Defense Secretary Hegseth. Tune into #TheBrief at 6pm ET on @cnni and CNN All Access.
